description: Unofficial Scorchio fan-art animated companion inspired by the yellow Neopets catalogue form. Nine original states include a gentle exhale toward a paper sail, unfolding two membrane wings, steadying the sail, smoothing a note against the single thick tail, biped movement in three directions and a small wing-balanced hop. Crown spikes and belly panels use a fixed simplified sprite map; choreography is original fan art rather than an official Neopets animation.
author: Cozy Critters Studio
